title: A family's scoreboard row, each number traced to its results and records
request: The owner: do the rest of the plan non-stop; the survey of phase 9 found no per-family scoreboard row.
spec: PHASE9_LEARNING_LOOP_PLAN.md 31.4 and 'What to track from day one': for each family, the challenges learned from, the check score, the sealed score, the playbook's size and the spend.
plan: Read the stored results and the playbook
Build the row from them and the loop records
A command to print and keep it

decisions.decision: The row is computed, never typed
decisions.why: every number names the result or record it came from, so the curve can be checked

decisions.decision: It is written to the workspace, not committed
decisions.why: a generated file in the repository needs its own freshness gate; the workspace's row is what a person reads

decisions.decision: The sealed score stays empty until the exam is read
decisions.why: the row reads stored results only; it never runs the sealed set

change: dclab_rnd/learning/scoreboard.py (family_row), the scoreboard command, tests/test_scoreboard_row.py, the plan's status.

measurements.name: the groups family's row on the workspace
measurements.gate: computed from stored results only, and the loop records replay
measurements.result: zero: check 7 of 20 (LRN-001), learning 3 of 20 (LRN-002), sealed unread; playbook version 6 with 3 draft bullets (none shown); EUR 0.45 spent; 2 packs learned from; no replay problem

outcome: A family's progress reads from one row, and every number in it traces back to a stored result or record.
lessons: A curve's zero should say when it was measured: LRN-001 and LRN-002 predate a later fix to the proposal, so the row shows their date.
risks: The zero is from 2026-10-23, before fix fa6be0a6; it should be measured again before any learning gain is claimed.
